svg.title: CipherVault - browser encryption tool with a live demo
svg.desc: RSA-3072 + AES-256-GCM hybrid encryption and a passphrase-encrypted vault (PBKDF2, 600,000 iterations) on the Web Crypto API, tested in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

g.text: Hybrid RSA + AES encryption and a passphrase-encrypted vault, running fully in
the browser with the Web Crypto API.
